Short title extent and commencement

THE COURT﷓FEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 1951
THE COURT-FEES
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1951
[This Act was
passed by the Pb Assembly on 17th Dec., 1951 ; assented to by the Governor of
the Pb on 11th January, 1952 ; and, pub lished in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary), dated: 19th January, 1952, page 29.]
[Punjab Act I of
1952]
[19th
January, 1952]
An Act further to amend the Court-fees Act, 1870
WHEREAS it is expedient further
to amend the Court-fees Act, 1870 (VII of 1870), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing ;
1. Short title extent and
commencement. (1) This Act may be called the Court-fees (Punjab Amendment)
Act, 1951.
(2) It extends to the Punjab
Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 30 of Act VII of 1870

THE COURT﷓FEES (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT 1951
THE COURT-FEES
(PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1951
[This Act was
passed by the Pb Assembly on 17th Dec., 1951 ; assented to by the Governor of
the Pb on 11th January, 1952 ; and, pub lished in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary), dated: 19th January, 1952, page 29.]
[Punjab Act I of
1952]
[19th
January, 1952]
An Act further to amend the Court-fees Act, 1870
WHEREAS it is expedient further
to amend the Court-fees Act, 1870 (VII of 1870), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing ;
2. Amendment of section 30 of
Act VII of 1870. In section 30 of the Court-fees Act, 1870, for the words
"the figure-head", the words "the crescent and star" shall
be substituted and the following proviso shall be added at the end, namely :--
"Provided that if any
document bearing a court-fee stamp of a design current in British India
immediately before the fifteenth day of August, 1947, and still current in the
Punjab is presented to the proper officer, he shall forthwith effect the
cancellation by punching out the figure-head so as to leave the amount
designated untouched."
